short_description: Checkout pods restart during peak traffic
description: The checkout Java service exceeded its container memory limit after a promotion increased request volume.
root_cause: A memory leak in the checkout service retained order objects until the Kubernetes container exceeded its 1 GiB limit.
recommended_actions: Capture a heap dump and identify retained objects before restarting the workload.
Roll back the leaking release and temporarily increase the container memory limit.
Add heap-usage and container working-set alerts at 80 percent.

verified_commands.explanation: Confirm OOMKilled state and container memory limits.
Roll back the most recent checkout deployment.

short_description: Order API cannot obtain database connections
description: Requests stalled after long transactions exhausted the PostgreSQL connection pool and produced lock waits.
root_cause: An unindexed reporting query held row locks and saturated the application connection pool.
recommended_actions: Identify and cancel only the confirmed blocking query after application-owner approval.
Add the missing report filter index using the normal database change process.
Set transaction timeouts and monitor pool utilization.

verified_commands.command: psql -c "SELECT pid, wait_event, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event IS NOT NULL;"
verified_commands.explanation: List sessions currently waiting on database resources.

verified_commands.command: psql -c "SELECT * FROM pg_locks WHERE NOT granted;"
verified_commands.explanation: Inspect ungranted locks without modifying database state.

description: The reverse proxy could not reach the inventory service because the deployment used the wrong target port.
root_cause: A Kubernetes Service targetPort mismatch routed gateway traffic to a port where the inventory pods were not listening.
recommended_actions: Compare the Service target port with the container listening port.
Correct the Service manifest and validate endpoints before promotion.
Add a deployment smoke test through the gateway.

verified_commands.command: kubectl get service inventory-api -n production -o yaml
verified_commands.explanation: Inspect the configured service and target ports.
Verify that ready pod endpoints are registered.

short_description: Log ingestion halted on worker nodes
description: A debug logging change filled the node filesystem and prevented agents from writing spool files.
root_cause: Unbounded debug logs exhausted the /var filesystem after log rotation was disabled in the new configuration.
recommended_actions: Restore log rotation and reduce the service log level.
Archive logs according to the retention policy before removing obsolete files.
Alert on filesystem consumption and inode exhaustion.

verified_commands.explanation: Check filesystem capacity for the affected volume.
Identify large log directories without deleting data.

short_description: Partner API calls time out after DNS migration
description: Workers could not resolve the partner hostname because an old DNS resolver remained in the runtime configuration.
root_cause: The application retained a deprecated DNS resolver address after the network migration.
recommended_actions: Validate name resolution from the affected runtime environment.
Deploy the approved resolver configuration and restart affected workers gradually.
Add DNS resolution to external dependency health checks.

verified_commands.explanation: Test resolution using the configured resolver.
Validate DNS, TLS, and connectivity to the partner health endpoint.
